synopsis.text:
The game opens on a vegetative theme: siblings Maru and Cori are sent to bed early for not eating their vegetables, whereupon they drift off to sleep and dream together. Suddenly, a spaceship crashes before them! "Lettuce check it out," urges Maru. From the ship appears a man dressed as a king. "I yam King Kale," he says, "Won't you peas peas help me?" Yes, the flaccid puns start to fly from this point and don't let up until the very end of the game. Those expecting witty dialogue from this game obviously have never spoken to a game programmer before.

It seems that King Kale needs the pair's help to prevent six worlds from being dominated by a mysterious being known as Vegetron. Every hero needs a nemesis, right? Unfortunately, despite managing to look almost evil in a cute way, Vegetron fails to come across as a threat to our heroes. One wonders how he even managed to dominate his back garden, let alone six planets, with his army of cute robots and "vegetable-themed" guardian minions, the latter of which are vulnerable in the same spots and which can be dispatched with almost the same pattern on each world. This is the same Vegetron who, after a single defeat at the hands of Maru, realizes the error of his ways and chooses to turn over a new leaf in a platitudinous soliloquy which goes on and on. That puts an end to Veggie's chances of reappearing in sequels without some kind of contrived plot twist.

Our two heroes, then, set off on an adventure to save the kings imprisoned by the boss guardians on each of the six worlds. This being a platform game, each world has its own theme and pitfalls that need to be dealt with. These include the anti-gravity of the Space Fortress, fire pits of the Hot Pepper Planet, black holes of the Star-Spngled [sic] Squash, and requisite icy madness of the Frozen Vegetable Section. There is also a seventh world where the final battle with Vegetron takes place.

Ninja Jajamaru: Ginga Daisakusen est un générique plateforme japonais qui a été plutôt inspiré par Super Mario Bros 3. Un project pour libérer ce jeu à l'étranger était en cour mais a été oublié avant d'avoir pu se concrétiser.

Jajamaru revient donc enfin dans le monde du défilement horizontal dans le cinquième et dernier opus de Famicom. Pour commencer, il ressemble à Super Mario Bros 3 comme un clone. Le style graphique est très similaire, et la barre d'état est presque exactement la même. Même si les armes préférées de Jajamaru dans le passé ont été les shuriken, ici il ne peut tuer les ennemis qu'en sautant sur ??leurs têtes. En maintenant le bouton B, vous commencez à courir sur place, vous permettant de s'élancer et faire des sauts plus élevés. Vous pouvez trouver des power-ups en frappant les blocs avec votre tête et vous pouvez sauter également sur eux.

Eines Abends, als Jajamaru und Sakurahime einen seltenen Meteoritensturm beobachteten, wurden sie Zeuge der Bruchlandung eines UFOs hinter einem nahe gelegenen Berg. Im Inneren des Raumschiffs entdeckten sie den Großen Galaktischen König. Der König behauptete, der böse Don Destroida habe gerade seinen kostbaren Stern in einen mechanischen Planeten voller furchterregender Roboter verwandelt. Unsere Helden beschließen, dass es an ihnen liegt, das Universum vor Don Destroida und seiner Roboterhorde zu retten. Jajamaru und Sakurahime erhalten vom Großen Galaktischen König Hämmer, bevor sie mit dem Schiff des Königs in den Weltraum aufbrechen.

Ninja Jajamaru: Ginga Daisakusen es una plataforma genérica japonesa que está inspirada por Super Mario Bros 3. Estuvo en proyecto para lanzar este juego en el extranjero pero finalmente no pudo materializarse.
Jajamaru finalmente regresa al mundo del desplazamiento horizontal en la quinta y última obra de Famicom. Para empezar, se parece a Super Mario Bros 3 como un clon. El estilo gráfico es muy similar, y la barra de estado es casi exactamente la misma. A pesar de que las armas favoritas de Jajamaru en el pasado han sido shuriken, aquí solo puede matar enemigos saltando sobre sus cabezas. Al mantener presionado el botón B, comienza a correr en el lugar, lo que le permite saltar y realizar saltos más altos. Puedes encontrar potenciadores golpeando los bloques con la cabeza y también puedes saltar sobre ellos.

Jajamaru torna finalmente nel mondo dello scorrimento laterale nella quinta e ultima puntata del Famicom. Per cominciare, sembra Super Mario Bros 3 come clone. Lo stile grafico è molto simile e la barra di stato è quasi esattamente la stessa. Anche se le armi preferite di Jajamaru in passato sono state le shuriken, qui può uccidere i nemici solo saltando loro sulla testa. Tenendo premuto il pulsante B, inizi a correre sul posto, permettendoti di sfrecciare in avanti e fare salti più alti. Puoi trovare potenziamenti colpendo i blocchi con la testa e puoi anche saltarci sopra.

O jogo começa com um tema vegetativo: os irmãos Maru e Cori são mandados para a cama cedo por não comerem seus vegetais, e então caem no sono e sonham juntos. De repente, uma nave espacial cai diante deles! “Alface, olha só”, incita Maru. Do navio surge um homem vestido de rei. "Eu sou rei Kale", diz ele, "você não vai me ajudar?" Sim, os trocadilhos flácidos começam a voar a partir deste ponto e não diminuem até o final do jogo. Aqueles que esperam diálogos espirituosos deste jogo obviamente nunca falaram com um programador de jogos antes.
